food_culture: Most households eat less than they need, and the children are fed first.
commoner_resentments: Talk among neighbours turns, sooner or later, to what the Household Council has got wrong lately. Many feel that those in charge should be doing more to see everyone fed.
outsider_impressions: Nothing of weight is agreed here without the leave of the Household Council. Hunger is in the place, and a visitor sees it in thin faces. Petitions and permissions take a long time here, and visitors are told to wait.
dawn_work: Dawn work is the search for food: people are out before light to see what can be found.

food_culture: Most households eat less than they need, and the children are fed first.
commoner_resentments: People put up with the Elder Council, but they expect little of it. Short rations are the talk of every household, and patience is wearing thin.
outsider_impressions: Visitors learn early that it pays to stay on good terms with the Elder Council. Hunger is in the place, and a visitor sees it in thin faces. Nobody stands guard here, and a visitor walks in unchallenged.
dawn_work: Every hand that can be spared is out at first light, and what comes in is counted before it is eaten.

food_culture: There is not enough food to go round, and everyone knows it.
commoner_resentments: Many here feel that the Feudal Stewardship no longer listens to people like them. There is grumbling in every kitchen about how little there is to put on the table.
outsider_impressions: Several powers carry weight here, and a visitor soon learns not to assume which one matters most. Visitors are told to keep to the roads and not to wander off them. Order here depends on people keeping it among themselves.
dawn_work: The beasts are seen to before light, and nothing they give is wasted.
